## Multi-Species Trend Over Time
The data has dynamically parsed detection counts for all target datasets `Gen_alg`, `Ran_ado`, and `Cal_chi` utilizing native chronological Excel indexing logic directly over the raw files on disk. (Due to `Sed_lan` completely lacking chronological correlation in the Excel metadata table, it has been appropriately preserved in the total density graph below).

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv('results/Gen_alg_summary.csv')
df['Collection_Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Collection_Date'])

# Create an interactive responsive line timeline grouping by date and species (Dropping Unmapped Sed_lan exclusively for chronological views)
df_chrono = df.dropna(subset=['Collection_Date']).copy()

df_grouped = df_chrono.groupby(['Collection_Date', 'Species'])['Detections'].agg(['mean', 'std']).reset_index()
df_grouped['upper'] = df_grouped['mean'] + df_grouped['std'].fillna(0)
df_grouped['lower'] = (df_grouped['mean'] - df_grouped['std'].fillna(0)).clip(lower=0)

fig = go.Figure()

colors = {
    'Gen_alg': ('blue', 'rgba(0,100,255,0.2)'),
    'Ran_ado': ('#e6005c', 'rgba(230,0,92,0.2)'),
    'Cal_chi': ('#ff9900', 'rgba(255,153,0,0.2)')
}

for sp in df_grouped['Species'].unique():
    sp_df = df_grouped[df_grouped['Species'] == sp]
    line_col, fill_col = colors.get(sp, ('green', 'rgba(0,255,0,0.2)'))
    
    # Add lower and upper bound with a filled polynomial polygon
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=sp_df['Collection_Date'].tolist() + sp_df['Collection_Date'].tolist()[::-1],
        y=sp_df['upper'].tolist() + sp_df['lower'].tolist()[::-1],
        fill='toself',
        fillcolor=fill_col,
        line=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0)'),
        hoverinfo="skip",
        showlegend=False
    ))
    
    # Add mean line
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=sp_df['Collection_Date'],
        y=sp_df['mean'],
        mode='lines+markers',
        name=f'{sp} Average',
        line=dict(color=line_col)
    ))

fig.update_layout(
    title='Comparative Pollen Detections Over Collection Dates',
    xaxis_title='Date of Collection',
    yaxis_title='Average Pollen Count',
    margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=40, b=20), autosize=True
)
fig.show()
```

## Total Absolute Density Profile
Aggregates the total absolute detection hits for all completely merged frameworks unconditionally.

```{python}
df_total = df.groupby('Species')['Detections'].sum().reset_index()

fig3 = px.bar(df_total, x='Species', y='Detections', text='Detections', color='Species',
              color_discrete_map={'Gen_alg': 'blue', 'Ran_ado': '#e6005c', 'Cal_chi': '#ff9900', 'Sed_lan': '#00b3b3'},
              title='Total Aggregate Pollen Detections Distributed by Specimen Class')

fig3.update_traces(textposition='outside')
fig3.update_layout(xaxis_title='Dataset Type', yaxis_title='Total Detections Logged',
                   margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=40, b=20), autosize=True)
fig3.show()
```


## Average Density Profile
Aggregates the mean detection hits per sample across each evaluated species.

```{python}
df_mean = df.groupby('Species')['Detections'].mean().round(1).reset_index()

fig4 = px.bar(df_mean, x='Species', y='Detections', text='Detections', color='Species',
              color_discrete_map={'Gen_alg': 'blue', 'Ran_ado': '#e6005c', 'Cal_chi': '#ff9900', 'Sed_lan': '#00b3b3'},
              title='Average Pollen Detections Per Sample by Specimen Class')

fig4.update_traces(textposition='outside')
fig4.update_layout(xaxis_title='Dataset Type', yaxis_title='Average Detections',
                   margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=40, b=20), autosize=True)
fig4.show()
```


## Specimen Variance Distribution

```{python}
import plotly.express as px

fig2 = px.box(df_chrono, x='Collection_Date', y='Detections', color='Species', points="all",
              color_discrete_map={'Gen_alg': 'blue', 'Ran_ado': '#e6005c', 'Cal_chi': '#ff9900'},
              title='Pollen Detections Variance Per Collection Date (Chronologically Mapped Datasets Only)',
              hover_data=['Join_Code', 'Original_File'])
fig2.update_layout(xaxis_title='Date of Collection', yaxis_title='Pollen Count',
                   margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=40, b=20), autosize=True)
fig2.show()
```

## Raw Tabular Metrics

```{python}
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# Select a subset of highly relevant columns for presentation including unmatched rows
cols_to_show = ['Join_Code', 'Species', 'Collection_Date', 'Detections', 'Focus_Status', 'Original_File']

# Append excel attributes if they exist
for optional in ['barvivo [μl]', 'na sklíčko [μ]']:
    if optional in df.columns:
        cols_to_show.append(optional)

df_display = df[cols_to_show].copy()

# Fix string representations explicitly 
if 'Collection_Date' in df_display.columns:
    df_display['Collection_Date'] = df_display['Collection_Date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

display(HTML(df_display.to_html(classes='table table-striped table-hover', index=False, na_rep='Unmapped')))
```
